unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted; none appear in this section's transcribed cells). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. The section crosses pages 18-19. Render verification resolves glued footnote markers on page 19: Other Current-FYTD Gross/Outlays is 300, and Proprietary Receipts Current-FYTD Applicable is 24. The three line-level Proprietary Applicable cells are standalone because each is the only Applicable source in its column; section-total Applicable cells are covered by exact total-row net identities.
